ThingDef.label: haggler module
ThingDef.description: A protocol-droid module loaded with a trade guild's negotiation tables. Fitted to a working protocol droid, it reads the trader across the table: temperament, patience, and when they are about to crack.

ThingDef.label: manifest decoder
ThingDef.description: A protocol-droid module holding a registry of known lost and stolen goods. Fitted to a working protocol droid, it says where a thing came from and who would miss it.

ThingDef.label: transponder scanner
ThingDef.description: A protocol-droid module that listens to the transponders goods radiate. Fitted to a working protocol droid, it flags stolen and lost stock before a word is exchanged.

ThingDef.label: price almanac
ThingDef.description: A protocol-droid market-analysis module: years of price records and the models to read them. Fitted to a working protocol droid, it shows full price histories and makes every negotiator sharper.

HediffDef.label: haggler module
HediffDef.description: A fitted haggler module. When this droid is in the trading party, or at the colony during a comms trade, the trader's temperament and patience can be read.

HediffDef.label: manifest decoder
HediffDef.description: A fitted manifest decoder. Reads the lost-and-stolen registry during trades.

HediffDef.label: transponder scanner
HediffDef.description: A fitted transponder scanner. Reads goods' transponders during trades.

HediffDef.label: price almanac
HediffDef.description: A fitted price almanac. Full price histories during trades, and every negotiator's Social gates lowered by 2.
